course_title: Product Packaging & Branding for Small Producers

say: Size your label, cost your pack, then test it.
This is the video for Module 2 of Product Packaging and Branding.
Many first labels fail for simple reasons. The label is too long and overlaps badly, or the text is cut off at the edge.

say: For example, Bisi in Ibadan packs groundnut butter in round jars. The body is 70 mm across and the straight part is 70 mm tall.

panel.heading: Bisi sizes a wrap label
items: Jar 70 mm across: 70 x 3.14 = about 220 mm
Add 5 mm overlap: length 225 mm
Straight part 70 mm, minus 10: height 60 mm
Add 3 mm bleed each side: canvas 231 x 66 mm
Keep text 3 mm inside the cut line

say: Now the cost. Bisi lists every packaging item: jar and lid 220 naira, label 60, foil seal 15, and a carton share of 25. That makes 320 naira.
She adds 5% for wastage, for labels that go on crooked or jars that crack. 320 times 1.05 is 336 naira.
The groundnut butter inside costs 750 naira.
Her labour is 150 naira.
And her share of transport, data and rent is 100 naira.
The full cost of one jar is 1,336 naira. Packaging is about a quarter of it.
To earn a 30% margin on the selling price, divide the full cost by 0.70.

panel.heading: Price for a real margin
items: Wholesale, 30% margin: 1,336 / 0.70
About 1,909, rounded to 1,900 naira
Retail: 1,900 / 0.75 = about 2,500 naira
Check similar products in two shops

panel.rule: Adding 30% to cost is markup. It is not a 30% margin.

say: A short run of 100 labels costs about 6,000 naira, or 60 naira per label. Little cash is tied up, and it is perfect for testing.
A run of 1,000 costs about 25,000 naira, only 25 naira each. But if your design or NAFDAC details change, unused labels become waste. Test with short runs first.
And when buying packaging online, ask for a sample first, and pay only into an account in the company's name.
Make five to ten real prototypes and try to break them. Turn liquid or oily products upside down on a paper towel for 24 hours. No marks means a pass.

Warm room for two or three days, away from children. Chilled drinks in a cooler.
Send two on a real delivery. Photograph among competitors from two metres.

say: Keep two in a warm room for two or three days, safely away from children. Put chilled drinks in a cooler. For example, Funke's paper zobo labels wrinkled in the ice, so she switched to waterproof vinyl.

Then ask five buyers what it is and what they would pay, not do you like it. Change one thing per round, and retest.

say: To remember. Add overlap and bleed, keep words in the safe zone, cost every item, divide to price, and test before a big run.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Wrap length = diameter x 3.14 plus overlap
3 mm bleed outside, 3 mm safe zone inside
Cost everything, including wastage and labour
Price = full cost / (1 minus margin)
Test, ask, change one thing, retest
